summary: Writer text download meets the bounded browser Blob export scope.
findings: No confirmed defects: UTF-8 Blob creation, object-URL cleanup, accessible action, status feedback, tests, and documentation are present.
evidence_refs: npm run verify passed: 35 app tests, 67 inventory tests, Playwright, static build, JSDoc, and size check
residual_risks: ODT, OOXML, PDF, multi-paragraph serialization, File System Access, download history, printing, and broad LibreOffice parity remain separate tasks.
